description: Construct-coverage allowlist for constructcheck/run.js. DENY BY DEFAULT: a key in `allow` means a human has verified that construct converts correctly on a real migrated page (source AsciiDoc -> MDX). Keys are `category:token` exactly as the gate reports them. Add a key only after checking the construct on the page(s) the gate cites. `notes` is a sibling map (key -> one-line evidence for why it was trusted); the gate ignores it, it is the audit trail.

notes.ast-context:paragraph:
->

. Layer-1 normalized text matches golden on all 314 migrated pages (cloud+operator).
notes.ast-context:section: -> ##/### headings. Layer-2 heading counts match per level (h2-h6 exact) on all 314 pages.
notes.ast-context:preamble: lead content before first section -> plain paragraphs; text-backed (create-account, add-kafka-mapping).
notes.ast-context:ulist: -> `-` bullets. listItems count exact on all 314; nesting depth (fidelity-blind) verified: kafka 3-level, operator phone-homes 2-level.
notes.ast-context:olist: -> `1.`. listItems count exact on all 314; nesting verified create-account / create-kafka-connection.
notes.ast-context:list_item: -> <li>. Layer-2 listItems count exact on all 314 pages: nothing dropped or added.
notes.ast-style:olist:arabic: top-level ordered list -> decimal, matches golden arabic on all 314 pages.
notes.ast-style:olist:loweralpha: nested ordered lists render decimal (Docusaurus/CommonMark standard), NOT AsciiDoc a/b/c. Deliberate decision 2026-08-11: keep markers matched to the source markdown; no CSS override. Nesting itself is preserved (create-budget-tracker: separate nested <ol>).
notes.ast-context:admonition: AsciiDoc admonition block -> Docusaurus :::type. Both source forms verified: inline `NOTE:` and block `[NOTE]`+====/--. 29 cloud pages.
notes.ast-style:admonition:NOTE: -> :::note. Inline + block + list-continuation forms (create-account, invite-user, delete-account).
notes.ast-style:admonition:IMPORTANT: -> :::important. `important` registered as a custom admonition keyword in docusaurus.config (extendDefaults) so the type name survives 1:1 (backup-and-restore).
notes.ast-style:admonition:WARNING: -> :::warning. Block title case fixed 2026-08-11: convertAdmonition now emits :::warning[Title] from the .title div instead of demoting it to a body paragraph (migrate-to-cloud, queue). Verified in rendered DOM.
notes.bracket-style:tabs: [tabs] -> <Tabs>. cloud: create-account/create-serverless-cluster/get-started. operator: get-started, connect-outside-kubernetes (language tabs), incl. tab sets nested inside list items.
notes.ast-style:example:tabs: tab-styled example block -> <Tabs>/<TabItem value=slug label=term>. Same witnesses as bracket-style:tabs (cloud+operator).
notes.ast-context:example: ==== block. No plain/standalone example blocks exist in EITHER component (no bare [example] in source); every ==== is a tabs / admonition / collapsible container, all verified.
notes.delimited-block:example: ==== delimiter, same as ast-context:example: only ever a tabs/admonition/collapsible container (cloud+operator).
notes.ast-context:dlist: both roles verified in BOTH components: as a tab-set source ([tabs]+dlist) and as a genuine description list -> <dl>/<dt>/<dd> (cloud maploader-and-mapstore, operator high-availability-mode).
notes.delimited-block:open: -- open block. cloud: only ever tab content. operator: tab content + list-item grouping; blockOrInline handles nested blocks. Verified get-started (both components).
notes.ast-context:table: convertTable: inline cells + single header row -> GFM pipe table; block content / multi-row-header -> semantic <table> with markdown cell bodies. Cell text + table count fidelity-backed on all 314 pages.
notes.delimited-block:table: |=== table delimiter, same handling as ast-context:table.
notes.bracket-style:anchor: [[id]] -> id on the following heading (## Heading {/* #id */}). Every cloud anchor precedes a heading; anchor resolution also gated by refcheck + fidelity Layer 3. (cluster-side-modules: serializers/prereqs/deploy).
notes.bracket-style:cols=\"1a: column spec, 'a' = AsciiDoc block content -> forces semantic <table> with markdown cells (cluster-side-modules [cols=1a,2a]).
notes.bracket-style:cols=\"20: column spec with %width + 'a' block -> <table>; width % dropped (accepted per table-rework) (cloud data-structures, operator).
notes.bracket-style:cols=\"3: mixed plain/'a' widths -> <table> where any 'a' cell has block content (cluster-side-modules [cols=3,3a,4a,1a]).
notes.bracket-style:cols=\"h: 'h' = header column -> <th> preserved in tbody rows when routed to htmlTable by block content (maploader [cols=h,2,4]). NOTE: an h-column table with only inline cells would downgrade to a pipe table and lose row-headers; none exist in the corpus.
notes.bracket-style:cols=\"1: plain equal widths, inline cells -> GFM pipe table; widths dropped (operator [cols=1,1]).
notes.bracket-style:cols=\"25: 'm' monospace + 'a' block (operator [cols=25%m,75%a]): m column -> inline `code`, verified jvm-parameters.
notes.bracket-style:cols=\"30: same m+a class as cols=25 (operator management-center-clusters [cols=30%m,70%a]).
notes.bracket-style:cols=\"4: plain widths + options=header -> GFM pipe table with header row (operator api-ref [cols=4,8,4,2,4]).
notes.bracket-style:cols=\"5: plain widths + options=header -> pipe table (operator api-ref [cols=5,10]).
notes.bracket-style:cols=\"l: 'l' = literal column -> single-line literal cells render as inline `code` in a pipe table (operator image-registry [cols=l, l]).
notes.source-language:bash: [source,bash] -> ```bash fence, incl. list-nested. Language preserved 1:1. codeBlocks count fidelity-backed on all 314 pages.
notes.source-language:shell: -> ```shell (kept, not remapped to bash). cloud get-started, operator (186 fences).
notes.ast-context:listing: listing block -> fenced code. Same output as delimited-block:listing / source-language.
notes.bracket-style:source: bare [source] (no language) -> ```none (no-highlight). Only fires without a language; [source,LANG] is source-language instead (jdbc line 51).
notes.subs-override:[source,xml,subs=\"attribu: attribute substitution in a code block. NO-BAKING: {attr} kept literal; converter adds a ` vars` fence flag ONLY when the block actually contains {attr}; swizzled CodeBlock (String.js) substitutes at render from the version-aware variable table. refcheck-backed.
notes.subs-override:[source,shell,subs=\"attri: same vars mechanism. Proven end-to-end: operator get-started helm install --version={operator-chart-version} renders 5.19.0-snapshot, no placeholder leak.
notes.subs-override:[source,yaml,subs=\"attrib: operator advanced-networking: body is an example$ include, so substitution is via the OTHER path -- example-attributes-loader.js (chained before raw-loader) substitutes {attr} at BUILD time, version-aware, then <CodeBlock> renders it. Verified end-to-end: renders version: '5.7.0-slim', no placeholder leak. On-disk example file keeps {attr} (no baking).
notes.inline-macro:xref:: -> resolved link: internal xref -> /cloud/.. (or <a href>); cross-component xref -> absolute /hazelcast/latest/.. URL. URL-preservation + Layer-3 backed (create-account, create-kafka-connection).
notes.inline-macro:link:: external link -> [text](url). Attribute-href links (link:{attr}[..]) -> <Variable href/> which emits target=_blank rel=noopener. DEFERRED minor gap: 2 literal-URL links (Terms/Privacy on create-account) lose window=_blank new-tab; tracked in memory docusaurus-external-links-newtab (planned local rehype plugin). Conversion itself is correct.
notes.block-macro:image::: block image -> ![alt](../images/file), co-located. ACCEPTED micro-bake: an {attr} inside alt text is baked (markdown ![alt] cannot hold a <Variable>); 2 cloud images (serverless-app-server, enterprise-architecture) bake {hazelcast-cloud}->Cloud. alt is non-visible a11y text with a stable value. 0 operator.
notes.ast-context:image: image block (AST view of image::) -> same handling as block-macro:image:: (migrate-to-cloud).
notes.bracket-style:%collapsible: [%collapsible] example block -> <details>; block .title -> <summary>; body (incl. partial include) rendered inside. cloud stop-and-resume, operator connect-outside-kubernetes.
notes.include:partial: cloud-only. partial$ include -> factored to cloud/_partials/<name>.mdx, imported and rendered as a <PartialName/> component (10 partials). Verified render: stop-and-resume -> <PartialClusterData/>. See docusaurus-partials-preservation.
notes.include:relative: cloud-only. include of another page's tagged region (add-kafka-mapping <- add-postgres-mapping[tag=new-mapping-start]) -> tag-sliced content inlined (single-sourcing). fidelity-backed.
notes.passthrough:pass:[…]: cloud-only (delete-account :description: pass:q[..]). The pass:q content renders as the first body paragraph via {description}; inline markup inside (an xref) is processed -> [pausing](/cloud/stop-and-resume). No baking.
notes.inline-macro:pass:: same construct as passthrough:pass:[…] (delete-account). pass:q[..] detected also as an inline macro; identical handling.
notes.ast-context:colist: operator-only. Callout list under a code block -> <CodeCallouts> component; the code fence gets metastring="conums" so the swizzled CodeBlock draws circled badges. Verified render (backup-restore 5.16): 78 badges, 7 callout lists, internal xref in a callout resolves. See docusaurus-conum-rendering.
notes.ast-style:colist:arabic: operator-only. arabic-numbered callout list, same <CodeCallouts> handling as ast-context:colist.
notes.ast-context:open: -- open block (AST view). operator uses it for list-item grouping + tab content; same construct as the already-verified delimited-block:open. blockOrInline handles nested blocks (backup-restore).
notes.ast-style:admonition:CAUTION: operator-only. -> :::caution. 'caution' registered as a custom admonition keyword in docusaurus.config (extendDefaults), so the type name survives 1:1 (user-code-namespaces:93).
notes.conditional:ifdef::snapshot: operator-only. ifdef::snapshot[]..endif -> <IfSnapshot> component (src/components/IfSnapshot.tsx), which renders children only when useDocsVersion().banner==='unreleased' (latest-snapshot). Version-cut-safe, no per-version baking. ACCEPTED DIVERGENCE (user decision 2026-08-11): released branches v/5.17 + v/5.18 carry a STRAY `snapshot: true` in antora.yml (release-cut left it behind; 5.16 & older are clean), so production/golden SHOW the snapshot note on 5.17/5.18 while the migrated site hides it. The migrated behaviour is more correct (the note 'no Red Hat images for snapshot versions' is wrong on a release). This is the sole cause of the 2 image-registry fidelity failures; accepted + documented, NOT baked to match the buggy source. See docusaurus-conditionals-project.
notes.conditional:endif::: closes an ifdef/ifndef/ifeval; here the </IfSnapshot> boundary. Same handling as conditional:ifdef::snapshot.
notes.delimited-block:---: BENIGN detector artifact: `---` is a YAML document separator INSIDE an example$ .yaml file (jet-job-example.yaml), imported verbatim as code content. Not an AsciiDoc block; no conversion applies.
BENIGN detector artifact: `...` is an omitted-content ellipsis INSIDE a [source,xml] listing (high-availability-mode); code content, not a block delimiter (lexical scan doesn't track block context). Rendered verbatim in the fence.
notes.delimited-block:literal: `....` literal block -> code block. Standard handling; fidelity-backed (operator-tutorial-expose-externally, green).
notes.include:example [x-comp]: operator-only (180 source occ / 152 output pages). Cross-component example$ include -> import Ex_.. from '../examples/file' rendered via <CodeBlock>; example-attributes-loader substitutes {attr} at build (version-aware) before raw-loader. On-disk example keeps {attr} (no baking). Verified end-to-end: advanced-networking yaml renders version 5.7.0-slim, no placeholder leak. Uniform import path across all pages. See docusaurus-example-includes-decision.
